request: Create a brief patient-education scene that explains what peripartum cardiomyopathy is.

candidates.text: 1. In women with a history of HF or cardiomyopathy, including previous peripartum cardiomyopathy, patient-centered counseling regarding contraception and the risks of cardiovascular deterioration during pregnancy should be provided.
entities: women with a history of HF or cardiomyopathy

candidates.text: 2. In women with acute HF caused by peripartum cardiomyopathy and LVEF <30%, anticoagulation may be reasonable at diagnosis, until 6 to 8 weeks postpartum, although the efficacy and safety are uncertain.
entities: women with acute HF caused by peripartum cardiomyopathy

candidates.text: It is recommended to inform women with HFrEF about the risk of deterioration of the condition during gestation and peripartum.
entities: risk of deterioration of the condition during gestation and peripartum

candidates.text: It is recommended to anticipate the timing of delivery to ensure safe and effective peripartum anticoagulation.
3. In patients with cardiomyopathy, a 3-generation family history should be obtained or updated when assessing the cause of the cardiomyopathy to identify possible inherited disease.
5. In patients with HF or cardiomyopathy, CMR can be useful for diagnosis or management.
